column2: [intro]
In my life, everyone used to say,
Tea was for the old, stuck in yesterday.
But one day I dared, made my own choice,
Now tea makes my voice dance with joy and rejoice.
Tea, oh tea, it never seems so grand,
But once you taste it, my palate's in a dance band.
Tea, oh tea, it's seriously divine,
Just need to choose the best one to be fine.
Then I discovered every kind and style,
Green, black, and infusions that beguile.
I tasted the wildest flavors and hues,
Now I'm hooked, can't seem to refuse.

But once you taste it, my palate's in a dance band.
Tea, oh tea, it's seriously divine,
Just need to choose the best one to be fine.
